summary: Build whistleblowing controls, retaliation safeguards, and board-ready reporting in 5 days. Enroll for practical governance training.
lede: Whistleblowing and speak-up systems provide ways to report concerns and help organizations assess cases, protect confidentiality, and manage retaliation risks. For professionals who oversee reporting channels, investigate concerns, or govern misconduct response, this course develops practical skills in mapping reporting routes, applying triage and escalation controls, and tracking cases through ethics metrics and board summaries.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage reporting channels, investigate concerns, or govern ethics and misconduct response.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: working knowledge of corporate governance, compliance, HR case handling, internal audit, or conduct risk processes. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable reviewing policy documents, case logs, escalation paths, and basic dashboard reports. The course is taught at advanced level, with concept-level treatment of AI-assisted case triage and operational-level treatment of whistleblowing governance tools.
